speaker: Unknown
en: What would be your biggest advice to other founders on how to get them and how to get the most out of them as a founder of a company?
zh: 对于其他创始人,关于如何搞定他们、以及作为公司创始人如何从他们身上获得最大价值,你最大的建议是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, we made a lot of mistakes with that too.
zh: 嗯,在这方面我们也犯过很多错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now it's probably four or five years that we invest in sport.
zh: 现在大概有四五年了,我们一直在投资体育领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because obviously we have charts, but we were sponsoring the UAE team with Pogacar.
zh: 因为显然我们有 Charles,但我们还赞助了拥有 Pogacar 的 UAE 车队。

speaker: Unknown
en: Pogacar was installing our product every single night at each hotel of each stage of the Tour de France since last year.
zh: 从去年开始,Pogacar 在环法自行车赛每个赛段的每家酒店,每晚都在安装我们的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: We didn't even know.
zh: 我们当时甚至不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: He won last year and then he won this year.
zh: 他去年赢了,然后今年又赢了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they reach out after the first year and say, look, Pogacar did everything on his own.
zh: 所以第一年结束后他们联系我们说,你看,Pogacar 全程都是自己搞定的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We bought the product.
zh: 我们是自己买的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now everybody in the team wants it.
zh: 现在车队里每个人都想要。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can we do something together?
zh: 我们能不能一起做点什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: So we sponsor the UAE team this year.
zh: 所以今年我们赞助了 UAE 车队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we are in Padel with Arturo Coelho and Federico Cingotto, so number one and number three in the world.
zh: 然后我们在板式网球领域有 Arturo Coelho 和 Federico Cingotto,世界排名第一和第三。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are in tennis where we sponsor a lot of coaches, including the coach of Sabalenka and many others.
zh: 我们还在网球领域赞助了很多教练,包括 Sabalenka 的教练以及许多其他人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then there are a lot of top, top athletes that use our product.
zh: 还有很多顶尖、顶尖的运动员在使用我们的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not public.
zh: 这没有公开。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what would you advise founders on lessons from how to get great talent, and then it can be celebrity ambassadors too, pop stars, DJs, you name it, and how to get the most out of them?
zh: 那么对于如何获得优秀的人才——也可以是名人大使、流行歌星、DJ 等等,以及如何从他们身上获得最大价值,你会给创始人什么建议?

speaker: Unknown
en: Or do they just not out of them?
zh: 还是说根本无法从他们身上获得价值?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, there are two conditions for any deal now.
zh: 嗯,现在任何交易都有两个条件。

speaker: Unknown
en: First, they need to use the product.
zh: 如果他们已经在用了,是自己买的,那很好,现在我们可以谈不做交易这件事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: If they already use it, they bought it on their own, perfect, now we can talk about not doing a deal.
zh: 如果他们已经在用它了，他们是自己买的，那太好了，现在我们可以谈谈不做交易的事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: If not, they need to try it, and then we want to hear the feedback.
zh: 如果没有,他们需要先试用,然后我们想听他们的反馈。

speaker: Unknown
en: They need to know the product, otherwise it's just a pure business transaction and I don't like it.
zh: 他们必须了解产品,否则那就只是一笔纯粹的生意交易,而我不喜欢这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Second, I wanna have a direct relationship with them.
zh: 第二,我想和他们建立直接的关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Usually, sometimes managers, they don't want that, and they wanna try to be in the middle.
zh: 通常,有时候经纪人不想这样,他们想夹在中间。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if I don't have the direct relationship with the athlete, we're not gonna do the deal, because then it's just a financial deal, and at this point, we don't care.
zh: 但如果我和运动员没有直接关系,我们就不会做这笔交易,因为那样就只是一笔财务交易,而到了这个阶段,我们不在乎那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanna be connected to the athlete.
zh: 我想和运动员建立联结。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanna know that they love our product, and if they don't, it's fine, but then the relationship will never work, particularly in a product like ours, where these people, the biggest value they do is just by talking to their friends about how good our product is.
zh: 我想确认他们真的热爱我们的产品,如果他们不热爱,那也没关系,但那样这段关系永远不会成功,尤其是在像我们这样的产品上,这些人最大的价值就是向他们的朋友谈论我们的产品有多好。

speaker: Unknown
en: They really need to be both in.
zh: 他们真的必须全身心投入。

speaker: Unknown
en: If they just have a stake in our company because they put a few million dollars, you don't go anywhere.
zh: 如果他们只是因为投了几百万美元而持有我们公司的股份,那你什么也得不到。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who would you most like to have on the cap table who you don't have?
zh: 你最想请进股权结构表但还没请到的人是谁？

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably... Do you have Cristiano Ronaldo?
zh: 大概是……你有克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: He would be amazing.
zh: 那就太棒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Have you seen pictures of him training?
zh: 你看过他训练的照片吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 看过。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a straight man.
zh: 我是直男。

speaker: Unknown
en: My God, this guy's body is incredible.
zh: 我的天，这家伙的身体太不可思议了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I looked at it, and then I looked at it myself, and I just felt like, oh, dear, Harry.
zh: 我看了他的，再看看我自己的，我就觉得，天哪，哈利啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: For us, there is a big difference between the athletes that we can disclose and the athletes that use the product.
zh: 对我们来说，我们可以公开的运动员和实际使用产品的运动员之间有很大的差别。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some of the top, top tennis players, they ping us.
zh: 一些最顶尖、顶尖的网球运动员会联系我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then in all the Grand Slam, they sleep on our product.
zh: 然后在所有大满贯赛事期间，他们都睡在我们的产品上。

speaker: Unknown
en: In F1, we have probably 80% of Formula 1 drivers sleeping on the product, including the people that are winning.
zh: 在 F1，我们大概有 80% 的 F1 车手睡在这个产品上，包括那些正在夺冠的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we are not allowed to share that, right?
zh: 但我们不被允许透露这些，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a private, confidential relationship.
zh: 这是私密、保密的关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you have any wild stories of delivering it somewhere crazy for someone last minute because they need it before?
zh: 你们有没有什么疯狂的故事，比如为某人在最后一刻把产品送到什么疯狂的地方，因为他们之前需要用上？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, yeah.
zh: 有，有。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't need to say the person.
zh: 你不用说那个人是谁。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, yeah.
zh: 有，有。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not sure the name, but there is this really, really famous football player.
zh: 名字我不确定，但有一位非常、非常有名的足球运动员。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so he tries the product at a friend's house, and then his team reaches out and says, you know, the athlete wants the product.
zh: 他在朋友家试用了产品，然后他的团队联系我们说，你知道，这位运动员想要这个产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you install it for him?
zh: 你们能帮他安装吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you come and let him try it at home?
zh: 你们能来让他在家试试吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So the team goes, but once they get there, he has this very unique, special size 300K mattress.
zh: 于是团队就去了，但到了那里发现，他有一张非常独特、特殊的 30 万美元的床垫。

speaker: Unknown
en: And our product doesn't fit because we have, I don't know, the queen, the king, not the standard sizes, but this was unique and customized.
zh: 我们的产品装不上去，因为我们有，我不知道，女王尺寸、国王尺寸，都不是标准尺寸，但这张是独特定制的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the team is leaving, but then the athlete says, no, no, no, no, okay, would you mind installing these in my kids' room?
zh: 团队正准备离开，但那位运动员说，不不不不，好吧，你们介意装在我孩子们的房间里吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: They say, fine, because that was a standard-sized mattress, and so we install it there.
zh: 他们说，行，因为那是标准尺寸的床垫，所以我们就装在那里了。

speaker: Unknown
en: A week later, the athlete calls us and say, look, I'm gonna give away my 300K mattress, but I'm gonna move eight-slip in my bedroom.
zh: 一周后，那位运动员打电话给我们说，听着，我打算把那张 30 万美元的床垫送人，但我要把八张睡垫搬进我的卧室。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need it for my own performance.
zh: 我需要它来提升我自己的表现。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so he threw away the 300K mattress, and now he sleeps on eight-slip.
zh: 于是他扔掉了那张 30 万美元的床垫，现在他睡在八张睡垫上。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was really sick.
zh: 那真是太酷了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, there is this other story that is really cool.
zh: 哦，还有一个故事特别精彩。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we give one of the most famous actors in the world gets our product as a gift, and he loves it.
zh: 我们把产品当作礼物送给了世界上最著名的演员之一，而他非常喜欢。

speaker: Unknown
en: He absolutely loves it.
zh: 他简直爱不释手。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then he buys 10 of our products for everybody in his family.
zh: 然后他为家里的每一个人买了 10 件我们的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I go to this dinner, and this famous actor comes in, and there is me and some top, top CEOs, but CEOs of 100 billion-plus companies, right?
zh: 后来我去参加一个晚宴，这位著名演员走了进来，在场的有我和一些顶尖、顶尖的 CEO，不过都是千亿级公司的 CEO，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: He starts shaking hands, and he spends literally three seconds with everybody, like three seconds.
zh: 他开始和每个人握手，和每个人只待了真的就三秒钟，就三秒钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then he comes to me, and he realizes I'm the CEO of Eight Sleep.
zh: 然后他走到我面前，意识到我是 Eight Sleep 的 CEO。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at that point, we start talking together for literally five minutes, to the point where the other CEOs, before, they were looking at me like, who is this guy?
zh: 从那一刻起，我们真的聊了五分钟，聊到之前那些 CEO 看我的眼神像是“这家伙是谁？”

speaker: Unknown
en: And after that, they were looking at me like,
zh: 而在那之后，他们看我的眼神变成了，

speaker: Unknown
en: With a lot of respect.
zh: 充满敬意。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the most amount of eight sleeps one person has bought?
zh: 一个人最多买过多少个 Eight Sleep？

speaker: Unknown
en: A very famous person that everybody knows has 55 for his houses, but then there are other people that buy through embassies and they bought in the hundreds.
zh: 一位人人都认识的非常著名的人士为他的各处房产买了 55 个，但还有一些人通过大使馆购买，买了几百个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Someone bought 55 for their houses?
zh: 有人为他们的房产买了 55 个？

speaker: Unknown
en: What?
zh: 什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you get a discount?
zh: 有折扣吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, these people don't ask for a discount.
zh: 没有，这些人不会要折扣。

speaker: Unknown
en: They just reach out to their team and they just ask to help for the setup or not to play such an order because that is wild.
zh: 他们只是联系自己的团队，请他们帮忙安装，或者说不要下这么大的订单，因为那太疯狂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I love that.
zh: 我很喜欢这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, there is another story.
zh: 嗯，还有另一个故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is this couple and they reach out because wherever they go, if they stay in a hotel for, I believe, longer than three or four nights, they buy any sleep to install in that hotel.
zh: 有一对夫妇，他们联系了我们，因为不管他们去哪里，如果他们在一家酒店住的，我记得，超过三四个晚上，他们就会买任何的 8Sleep 安装到那家酒店里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, because they can't sleep without that and obviously they're...
zh: 是啊，因为没有那个他们就睡不着，显然他们……

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you mind that 8Sleep is such a premium product?
zh: 你介意 8Sleep 是如此高端的产品吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Would you like it to be more for everyone?
zh: 你希望它能更面向所有人吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: We want to democratize sleep.
zh: 我们想让睡眠民主化。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the way I always say is, imagine if we were Tesla, we are the Model S. There will be the Roadster, so there will be something even better.
zh: 我一直这么说：想象一下，如果我们是特斯拉，我们是 Model S。将来还会有 Roadster，所以会有更好的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you will also see us coming out with the Model X and Y and 3.
zh: 但你也会看到我们推出 Model X、Y 和 3。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you worry about income inequality?
zh: 你担心收入不平等吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I know it's kind of a, but we've talked about people just buying 55.
zh: 我知道这有点……但我们谈到过有人直接买 55。

speaker: Unknown
en: You operate in a world where you see extreme wealth.
zh: 你所处的世界能看到极端的财富。

speaker: Unknown
en: I do as well.
zh: 我也是。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you share the concerns?
zh: 你有同样的担忧吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I do.
zh: 我有。

speaker: Unknown
en: The way I think is, okay, how do I democratize better sleep?
zh: 我的想法是，好，我怎么让更好的睡眠民主化？

speaker: Unknown
en: If our product was $100, probably by now we would have sold billions, literally, because people really, really like the benefits of what we do.
zh: 如果我们的产品是 100 美元，到现在可能我们已经卖出了几十亿，真的，因为人们非常非常喜欢我们产品带来的好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it's our job as a group of, you know, an engineering group, even if I'm not an engineer, to make sure that we can keep reducing prices so everybody can get better sleep.
zh: 所以作为一群人，一群工程人员，即使我不是工程师，我们的职责就是确保我们能持续降价，让每个人都能睡得更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: You said earlier about your co-founder, Alexandra.
zh: 你之前提到你的联合创始人 Alexandra。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hope it's okay.
zh: 希望这么说不冒昧。

speaker: Unknown
en: She's also your wife.
zh: 她也是你的妻子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yep.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: How does that work most efficiently?
zh: 那怎样运作才最高效？

speaker: Unknown
en: What lessons do you have?
zh: 你有什么经验教训？

speaker: Unknown
en: What works?
zh: 什么有效？

speaker: Unknown
en: What doesn't work?
zh: 什么无效？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 嗯。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have two different channels.
zh: 我们有两个不同的渠道。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one is Slack for work, and one is WhatsApp for private communication, so our life, and we never mix them.
zh: 一个是用于工作的 Slack，一个是用于私人沟通的 WhatsApp，也就是我们的生活，我们从不混用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I might be screaming on Slack, we have to get this done by the end of the day, and let's review this at 9 p.m.
zh: 所以我可能在 Slack 上吼，我们必须在今天结束前搞定这个，晚上 9 点来审一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then on WhatsApp, it might be, oh, what do we have for dinner?
zh: 然后在 WhatsApp 上可能是，哦，我们晚饭吃什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm craving pizza.
zh: 我想吃披萨。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't eat carbs.
zh: 我不吃碳水。

speaker: Unknown
en: We cheat on Friday.
zh: 我们周五作弊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Friday night is when we have pizza, but as a joke.
zh: 周五晚上是我们吃披萨的时候，但那算是个玩笑。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that is one.
zh: 这是第一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Second is I could talk about work all the time, like literally 24-7.
zh: 第二点是，我可以一直聊工作，真的是 24/7。

speaker: Unknown
en: I love that, and it helps me.
zh: 我喜欢这样，这对我有帮助。

speaker: Unknown
en: For her instead, like a certain point, she really wants to operate like if she was an executive that you wouldn't bother after a certain time in the night, like at 10, 10 p.m.
zh: 而对她来说，到了某个时间点，她就真的想像一个高管那样运作，好像过了晚上的某个时间，比如 10 点、晚上 10 点，你就不该去打扰她。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, if it's urgent, you can talk about that, but otherwise, if we are on the couch watching TV, don't just keep talking about work, because my brain needs to digest the information from the day, and that is how she performs.
zh: 好的，如果是紧急的事可以谈，但否则，如果我们坐在沙发上看电视，就不要一直聊工作，因为我的大脑需要消化白天的信息，而这就是她的运作方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then what I can do, I can slack her.
zh: 但我能做的是，我可以给她发 Slack。

speaker: Unknown
en: So sometimes we are on the couch watching TV, I start coming up with ideas and I start slacking her and her phone might be vibrating next to me and I know that it's me and it's completely fine and we don't talk about that even if I'm there writing a couple of messages.
zh: 所以有时我们坐在沙发上看电视，我开始冒出一些想法，就开始给她发 Slack，她的手机可能就在我旁边振动，我知道是我发的，这完全没问题，即使我就在那里写几条消息，我们也不谈论这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that doesn't irritate you?
zh: 而这不会让你恼火吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, because...
zh: 不会，因为……

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the way she framed it was extremely smart.
zh: 我觉得她设定的方式非常聪明。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she says, if I was an executive that was not sitting next to you, would you call them for the thing at 10, 15 p.m.?
zh: 她说，如果我是一个不坐在你旁边的高管，你会在晚上 10 点 15 分为这事打电话给他们吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Say, no.
zh: 我说，不会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she says, so just treat me how you would treat our VP of Ops, who is in New York.
zh: 她说，那就用你对待我们驻纽约的运营 VP 的方式来对待我。

speaker: Unknown
en: Would you not?
zh: 你不会吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I will call people at 10 or 11
zh: 我会在 10 点或 11 点给人打电话

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, it depends on if it's urgent or it's a random idea or it's something that we need to remember.
zh: 嗯,这取决于事情是否紧急,还是一个随机的想法,还是我们需要记住的某件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: If it's urgent, I call you at midnight, 2 a.m., 3 a.m., like, trust me, I'm going to come to your door at 5 a.m.
zh: 如果是紧急的事,我半夜、凌晨两点、凌晨三点都会给你打电话,相信我,凌晨五点我会到你家门口。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm that type of guy.
zh: 我就是那种人。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if I just have an idea that maybe for the next launch of the next product in the video we should talk about this, I can just send you a note.
zh: 但如果我只是有个想法,比如说在下一个产品发布的视频里我们应该谈谈这个,我就可以给你发个便条。

speaker: Unknown
en: When was the most challenging time?
zh: 最具挑战性的时候是什么时候?

speaker: Unknown
en: For the company?
zh: 是对公司而言吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: For the scaling of your relationship in the company, because there's always, like, breakpoints, you know?
zh: 对你们在公司里的关系发展而言,因为总是会有,你知道的,一些临界点。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the early days, I think.
zh: 我觉得是早期。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, probably, I don't know, four or five years, I think we are really fine-tuned, even because I'm extremely demanding.
zh: 现在,大概,不知道,四五年之后,我觉得我们已经磨合得很好了,也因为我是个极其苛刻的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a bit binary on the thing, like I'm a weirdo, and so I can be a husband on one side, but business-wise, no mercy.

en: I don't know.

en: But he literally decided five minutes before going in the conference room to tell his team.

en: I was in San Francisco.

en: Can you do this for me in terms of offer?

en: I think you cannot even compare, meaning if the people are really comparing the options between a company at a total different scale to you, they are probably the wrong people.
zh: 我认为这根本没法比较，意思是，如果一个人真的在拿一家和你规模完全不同的公司做比较，那他们很可能不是对的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or it's not that they are wrong fundamentally, like in our case is this person was tired of, you know, there is pressure at his sleep and he does hardware, so he needs to go to China, Vietnam, travel all the time.
zh: 或者说，从根本上说他们并不是错的，就像我们这个案例里，这个人是厌倦了，你知道，他做硬件有压力，他需要去中国、越南，不停地出差。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it was becoming a personal choice.
zh: 所以这逐渐变成了一个个人选择。

speaker: Unknown
en: But he's a hardcore guy.
zh: 但他是个硬核的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at the end of the day, he realized that this is what gives him energy.

en: And so he didn't even want that life.

en: And so sometimes it's still happening today.

en: Not even for the salary, but it means you're confused.

en: And I'm not talking because we are hardware versus software.

en: It's just, man, get your shit together.

en: Do you want to work at a very large company that has no certain standards and probably a certain profile, or you want to work at a sleep?

en: You will love this.

en: And so what they do is they start talking to a lot of companies.

en: And the reason is because they didn't have probably income or salary for every few months, they want to try to get a salary or income, and then they keep certain conversation open, and then they might take another job.

en: Does that not look terrible, switching so quickly?

en: From Chamath, that really is something.

speaker: Unknown
en: You cannot really compare us to one of these big companies that are already so big, where they are way more stable, and maybe you do 2, 3x.
zh: 你真的没法拿我们去和那些已经如此庞大的大公司相比，它们稳定得多，也许你能做个 2、3 倍。 [[854-注意]]

speaker: Unknown
en: At this leap, you should come to try to do 100 or 1,000x.
zh: 在这次跨越中，你应该来试着做到 100 倍或 1000 倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the team size, there are so many details that are totally different.
zh: 但团队规模，有太多细节完全不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we actually want people that are very driven and ambitious, but they need to be driven and ambition because of the right things.
zh: 所以我们其实想要非常有干劲和雄心的人，但他们得是因为正确的事情而有干劲、有雄心。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you think people care today more about upside in terms of 10, 100x or actually just certainty of cash?
zh: 你觉得现在的人更在意 10 倍、100 倍这种上行空间，还是其实只在意现金的确定性？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes, it may be more capped, but you will get a tender next year and that will be done as they are every year.
zh: 是的，上行空间可能更有上限，但你明年会拿到一次要约回购，而且这是每年都会有的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's completely fine, but then it goes back to get your shit together and understand what you need and probably what your family needs.
zh: 我觉得这完全没问题，但这就又回到那句话：把自己理清楚，搞明白你需要什么，可能还有你的家庭需要什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So another thing that I learned as a CEO is sometimes now, like we just promoted one of our best guys to VP of Engineering.
zh: 作为 CEO 我学到的另一件事是，有时候，比如我们刚把我们最好的人之一提拔为工程副总裁。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we were running a search for VP of Engineering, but he wanted the job.
zh: 当时我们正在为工程副总裁这个职位做外部招聘，但他想要这个职位。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what I told him is, look, we will run the search, but you have your own shot, so prove yourself.
zh: 我告诉他的是，听着，招聘我们会继续进行，但你也有你自己的机会，所以证明你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: He did insanely well for three months.
zh: 他这三个月做得非常出色。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we decided to go for him.
zh: 然后我们决定选他。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think it was very good that we run an external search so we could see other people as well, right?
zh: 但我觉得我们做了一次外部招聘非常好，这样我们也能看到其他人，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: I found that not the professional way to do it.
zh: 我发现这不是专业的做法。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what I told him is, I'm going to give you the job, but I don't want you to answer tonight.
zh: 但我告诉他的是，我会把这个职位给你，但我不想让你今晚就回答。

speaker: Unknown
en: You go and you talk to your wife because she has seen how hard you work over the past three months.
zh: 你回去和你妻子谈谈，因为她见证了你过去三个月工作有多努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: You were already working hard.
zh: 你本来就已经很努力了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The last three months, you went like 130%.
zh: 而最后这三个月，你达到了 130%。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so here is not just you committing to this life.
zh: 所以这不只是你一个人承诺于这种生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I give you the job, I expect you or I would like you that everything equal, you stay with us for the next two, three, four years.
zh: 如果我把这个职位给你，我期望你——或者我希望你——在其他条件相同的情况下，在接下来的两三四年里留在我们这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Otherwise, I'm not gonna bet on you.
zh: 否则，我不会押注于你。

speaker: Unknown
en: So go and talk to your wife.
zh: 所以去和你妻子谈谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: She has seen how hard you work and you guys, both of you need to commit because it's not just you, it's your family.
zh: 她见证了你工作有多努力，你们俩都需要做出承诺，因为这不只是你，还有你的家庭。

speaker: Unknown
en: Completely agree.
zh: 完全同意。

speaker: Unknown
en: I call it the power of pillow talk, which is why I will always spend time at a dinner party or a drinks party speaking to their partner, because I want them to actually know at the end of the day why I'm doing what I'm doing and how important my family is to me and what we build is together.
zh: 我称之为「枕边话的力量」，这也是为什么我总会在晚宴或酒会上花时间和他们的伴侣交谈，因为我希望他们最终真正知道我为什么做我在做的事，我的家庭对我有多重要，以及我们所构建的是我们共同的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so when they come home and have a shit day, it's like, but I do like Matteo and I know he's a good human.
zh: 这样当他们回家、度过糟糕的一天时，就会想：不过我确实喜欢 Matteo，我知道他是个好人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, exactly.
zh: 是的，没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Changes everything.
zh: 这会改变一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: And everybody has a family, right?
zh: 而且每个人都有家庭，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So we need to take care of them, but they also need to be bolting.
zh: 所以我们需要照顾好他们，但他们也需要全力以赴。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can I ask you, when we look at the team today, how big is the team?
zh: 我能问一下吗，看今天的团队，团队规模有多大？

speaker: Unknown
en: We're only 160 people.
zh: 我们只有 160 人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wow, that's small.
zh: 哇，那很小。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our revenue per employees is way higher than Apple.
zh: 我们的人均营收远高于 Apple。

speaker: Unknown
en: One thing I can tell you is, without disclosing our revenue, but other similar companies are probably in the 1,000 people at our revenue stage.
zh: 我可以告诉你的一件事是，在不披露我们营收的情况下，其他类似的公司在我们这个营收阶段大概有 1000 人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our output is 5x, but is average in Silicon Valley.
zh: 我们的产出是 5 倍，但这是硅谷的平均水平。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can I ask you, when we look then three years out, it's a reasonable time frame, it's not crazy out, but it's decent.
zh: 那我能问一下吗，往三年后看，这是一个合理的时间框架，不算太远，但也够长。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many people will you be then?
zh: 到那时你们会有多少人？

speaker: Unknown
en: 250 people making a billion.
zh: 250 人做出 10 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which function does not exist today that will be very important, or job?
zh: 今天不存在、未来会非常重要的职能部门或职位是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, we saw a change in email, but what I think is I started thinking of in terms of teams of two.
zh: 嗯，我们在邮件方面看到了变化，但我认为是我开始用两人小组的思路来思考。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is how I think for certain parts of the business, where I think you still want two people to have redundancy and you want two world-class people overseeing that area, but that area could be really big, right?
zh: 对于业务的某些部分，我就是这样思考的，我认为你仍然需要两个人来做冗余，需要两个世界级的人来监督那个领域，但那个领域可以非常大，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So like right now, our paid media team makes hundreds of millions and there are two people, but like two, 300 million, just the group.
zh: 比如现在，我们的付费媒体团队做出数亿美元，而只有两个人，大概 2、3 亿美元，就这一个组。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the way I like to keep the organization is extremely small and flat, and that is how we can be 160 people instead of 1,000, and similar companies are in the thousands.
zh: 所以我喜欢的组织方式是极其小而扁平，这就是为什么我们可以是 160 人而不是 1000 人，而类似的公司是几千人的规模。

speaker: Unknown
en: So which function today or which job today will be gone in five years' time and which will be created?
zh: 那么今天哪个职能部门或哪个职位在五年后会消失，哪个又会被创造出来？

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, I don't think anything will be gone.
zh: 再说一次，我不认为有什么会消失。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think you can do what you're doing with way less people or the same people be spread more horizontally to cover more areas, right?
zh: 我觉得你可以用少得多的人来做你正在做的事，或者让同样的人更横向地铺开来覆盖更多领域，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so maybe it's AI SEO, maybe the same person oversees this other section and this other section.
zh: 所以也许是 AI SEO，也许是同一个人同时负责这一块和另一块。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can be way leaner.
zh: 这样你可以精简得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now I have an AI internal tools team that didn't exist until six months ago and are the guys building these thousands of agents for internal.
zh: 现在我有一个 AI 内部工具团队，六个月前还不存在，他们就是为内部构建这数千个智能体的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you have a separate team for that.
zh: 而且你为这个单独设了一个团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't expect horizontal groups to do that.
zh: 你不指望横向的部门来做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, because this team needs to be very connected to the data engineering team because the agents need to have access to the data backend, the data pipeline of everything we do.
zh: 是的，因为这个团队需要和数据工程团队非常紧密地联系在一起，因为智能体需要访问数据后端、我们所做一切的数据管道。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, I don't know, the marketing agents need to make sure that it has perfect access to the revenue by country and the CAC by country.
zh: 所以，我不知道，营销智能体需要确保它能完美地访问按国家划分的收入和按国家划分的 CAC。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so fine tuning that, that is the real true challenge because you want to make sure that the agents are 100% correct.
zh: 所以微调这些，那才是真正的挑战，因为你要确保智能体 100% 正确。

speaker: Unknown
en: Other than email marketing, what agent has had the most significant impact?
zh: 除了邮件营销之外，哪个智能体产生了最重大的影响？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, the one for paid media, right?
zh: 嗯，付费媒体的那个，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Now we make hundreds of millions with these paid media agents.
zh: 现在我们靠这些付费媒体智能体赚取数亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now the other big one is in finance.
zh: 现在另一个大的在财务领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: Particularly in all these groups is where we save a lot of headcounts compared to normal companies, right?
zh: 尤其是在所有这些部门里， compared 于普通公司我们节省了大量 headcount，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably a company like ours should have, I don't know, a team of 20 people in finance.
zh: 一家像我们这样的公司大概应该有，我不知道，一个 20 人的财务团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our team is four people.
zh: 我们的团队是 4 个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just really like to keep teams small and try to see if I can 5X the output.
zh: 我就是真的喜欢保持团队小规模，然后试着看能不能把产出提高 5 倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really have love when I talk to investors to ask them to compare each of my teams and the quality of the output of each of my teams to other companies they have and the delta in size.
zh: 我真的很喜欢在和投资人交谈时，请他们把我的每个团队、每个团队的产出质量，和他们接触的其他公司做比较，以及规模上的差距。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're in 35 countries?
zh: 你们在 35 个国家？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the hardest country?
zh: 最难的国家是哪个？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, China because you don't sell on the website, so we have to reinvent everything.
zh: 嗯，中国，因为你不能在网站上销售，所以我们必须重新发明一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: Dude, I want to do a quick fire round, so I say a short statement, you give me your immediate thoughts.
zh: 老兄，我想来一个快问快答，我说一个简短的陈述，你给我你的即时想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many hours sleep do we really need today?
zh: 我们今天到底需要多少小时睡眠？

speaker: Unknown
en: At least seven.
zh: 至少 7 小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: Biggest sleep tip for me?
zh: 对我来说最重要的睡眠建议？

speaker: Unknown
en: Consistency and amount of hours.
zh: 规律性和睡眠时长。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you just nail those two things, you will be good.
zh: 只要你做好这两件事，你就会很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Eating before bed, any advice?
zh: 睡前吃东西，有什么建议吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's very personal.
zh: 这非常因人而异。

speaker: Unknown
en: For certain people it makes a difference, for others no, and it will change as you age.
zh: 对某些人有影响，对其他人没有，而且会随年龄改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: What have you changed your mind on most, in general, in the last year?
zh: 在过去一年里，总体而言，你在什么事情上改变想法最多？

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably in health in general, I think really 95% of the value is just to be consistent and do the right things without going too crazy in terms of, I don't know, products that you can take and supplements and all that.
zh: 大概是在健康方面总体上，我认为真的 95% 的价值就是保持一致并做对的事情，而不用在那些产品、补剂之类的东西上太疯狂。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you just have a very balanced life in terms of eating well, training and sleeping, then the score will take care of itself.
zh: 只要你在吃得健康、训练和睡眠方面过一种非常平衡的生活，那么分数自然会好。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's a kooky prediction, weird prediction you have about the future that you do stand by?
zh: 你有一个什么样的关于未来的古怪预测、奇怪的预测，而且你确实坚持的？

speaker: Unknown
en: That kids that are being born now will never work, at least for money.
zh: 现在出生的孩子将永远不会工作，至少不会为了钱而工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then they might do it because of their passion.
zh: 然后他们可能会因为热爱而去做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you just explain that to me?
zh: 你能给我解释一下吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I don't think if a kid is born now, by the time they are 20 years old, they will ever work.
zh: 嗯，我认为如果一个孩子现在出生，等到他们 20 岁时，他们将永远不会工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: By then, I think AI will be at a point where humans don't work.
zh: 到那时，我认为 AI 会发展到人类不再工作的程度。

speaker: Unknown
en: They will do activities, social activities, even to help other humans.
zh: 他们会做各种活动、社交活动，甚至去帮助其他人类。

speaker: Unknown
en: What will we do then?
zh: 那时我们会做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what we need to discover.
zh: 这正是我们需要去发现的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I also have this pyramid of life about the importance of life.
zh: 我还有这个关于人生重要性的生命金字塔。

speaker: Unknown
en: And to me, it's a pyramid.
zh: 对我来说，它是一个金字塔。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the bottom, you have health, and then you have relationship, and then you have purpose.
zh: 在底部，是健康，然后是关系，然后是目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think this is what drives happiness.
zh: 我认为这就是驱动幸福的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the first thing you need to nail in your life is to be healthy.
zh: 所以你在人生中首先需要搞定的事是保持健康。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if you are unhealthy, almost nothing else matters, right?
zh: 因为如果你不健康，几乎其他一切都不重要了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have a cancer and you risk to die in the next two, three months, you can't be happy.
zh: 如果你得了癌症，可能在两三个月内有死亡风险，你不可能快乐。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once health is on track, you focus on relationship.
zh: 一旦健康走上正轨,你就要专注于人际关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Doesn't matter what kind of relationship, it could be a partner, it could be your family, it could be your friends, but you need to have relationship of other people, right?
zh: 不管是什么样的关系,可以是伴侣,可以是家人,也可以是朋友,但你需要和其他人有关系,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: If you are extremely rich and healthy, but completely alone and nobody wants you, you can be happy.
zh: 如果你极其富有又健康,但完全孤独、没有人需要你,你也能快乐。

speaker: Unknown
en: The third is purpose.
zh: 第三是目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: And purpose is extremely important, right?
zh: 目标极其重要,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So once you're healthy, once you have great relationship, you need to have a purpose in your life.
zh: 所以一旦你健康了,一旦你有了很好的人际关系,你就需要在生活中有一个目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to work towards something.
zh: 你需要朝着某件事努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it doesn't need to be, you know, financially related.
zh: 而它不一定,你知道,和钱有关。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be anything that you really enjoy, but you need to have a purpose.
zh: 它可以是任何你真正享受的事情,但你需要有一个目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that is the part that we need to pay attention to.
zh: 而我认为这是我们需要注意的部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: What would you advise someone asking whether they should go to university today?
zh: 对于今天问是否应该上大学的人,你会给什么建议?

speaker: Unknown
en: No, 100% no.
zh: 不,百分百不要。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's useless.
zh: 没用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, if you want to have social activities, there is the social part, but I'm just talking in a very pragmatic way.
zh: 嗯,如果你想要社交活动,确实有社交这一面,但我只是从非常务实的角度来说。

speaker: Unknown
en: If they want to have a career, particularly in Silicon Valley as entrepreneurs, I think it's totally useless.
zh: 如果他们想要一份事业,特别是在硅谷当创业者,我认为那完全没用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you believe in universal basic income?
zh: 你相信全民基本收入吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it will have to happen, and I think probably as companies will get more efficient, and probably they will need less people working for them.
zh: 我认为它终将发生,而且我想大概随着公司变得更高效,它们可能需要更少的员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably they will get taxed
zh: 它们可能会被征税

speaker: Unknown
en: more to make sure that we can distribute universal income to everybody.
zh: 更多,以确保我们能把全民收入分配给每个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you think Bill Gates's suggestion was right that we should tax agent usage and token usage?
zh: 你认为 Bill Gates 建议我们应该对智能体使用量和 token 使用量征税是对的吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: The bottom line of a lot of companies will improve meaningfully over the next three, four, five, ten years.
zh: 未来三、四、五、十年,很多公司的利润底线将有意义地改善。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I just think we will need to readjust part of that bottom line to be distributed to people so everybody can have a comfortable life.
zh: 所以我只是认为,我们需要重新调整那部分利润底线,把它分配给人们,让每个人都能过上舒适的生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: Would you let your children use social media?
zh: 你会让你的孩子使用社交媒体吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: That is a good question.
zh: 这是个好问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't have an answer yet, but at some point I will have to figure it out.
zh: 我还没有答案,但到了某个时候我必须想清楚。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do you not know yet about parenting that you are wanting to know?
zh: 关于养育,你还不知道但想知道的是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I'll tell you something that I'm actually trying to do that could be slightly different.
zh: 嗯,我告诉你一件我实际正在尝试做的事,可能有点不一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: So with 8th Leap, we are lucky that we work with a lot of people that have been successful in sport, but it could be ballerinas, it could be chess players, or it could be even no great businessman.
zh: 通过 8th Leap,我们很幸运能和很多在体育领域成功的人合作,他们可以是芭蕾舞者,可以是国际象棋棋手,甚至可以不是什么了不起的商人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm trying to talk to all their dads, and I want to learn from their dads what they did, what they thought it worked and didn't work in how they raised their kids to then learn how I can be a dad one day.
zh: 我试图和他们所有的父亲交谈,我想从他们的父亲那里了解他们做了什么,他们认为在养育孩子的方式中哪些管用、哪些不管用,从而学习我将来有一天该怎么当父亲。

speaker: Unknown
en: What did you learn?
zh: 你学到了什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm starting now to do my due diligence and interviews.
zh: 我现在刚开始做我的尽职调查和访谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: God, that would be a fascinating exercise.
zh: 天哪,那会是一次非常迷人的练习。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's amazing, right?
zh: 我只是想知道,他们认为他们做对了什么、做错了什么,才让他们的孩子成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because nobody thinks about, it doesn't need to be the dad.
zh: 因为没人想到,不一定非得是父亲。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be the mom.
zh: 也可以是母亲。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just want to learn what do they think they did right or wrong for their kids to be successful.
zh: 我只是想了解,他们认为他们做对了什么或做错了什么,才让他们的孩子取得成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: And to me, successful could be even a doctor, right?
zh: 而对我来说,成功甚至可以是一名医生,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not talking about athletes or sports.
zh: 我说的不是运动员或体育。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I want to learn from people that just went through that.
zh: 但我想向那些亲身经历过的人学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm sure they are.
zh: 而且我相信他们是。

speaker: Unknown
en: They made mistakes.
zh: 他们犯过错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know what my mother did?
zh: 你知道我母亲做了什么吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: She dropped an image of perfection or morality or goodness that most parents have.
zh: 她放下了大多数父母都有的那种完美、道德或善良的形象。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know you kind of view your parents as good and always well-behaved and generally.
zh: 你知道,你通常会把父母视为善良的、总是行为端正的、大体上这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: She will talk to me in-depth about all of her fuck-ups and the lessons that she learned, things that you really wouldn't talk to your child about.
zh: 她会和我深入谈论她所有的搞砸的事和她学到的教训,那些你真的不会和孩子谈论的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: But in the depths of mistakes, you have lessons.
zh: 但在错误的深处,有教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: And how do I learn from her fuck-ups?
zh: 而我该如何从她搞砸的事中学习?

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you know what I mean?
zh: 你明白我的意思吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But most would be like, no, that was a dark episode of my life that I'm not going back to.
zh: 但大多数人会说,不,那是我人生中一段黑暗的插曲,我不会再回头提它。

speaker: Unknown
en: That I really appreciated.
zh: 这一点我真的很感激。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: You made me think of this thing.
zh: 你让我想到了这个事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't remember the exact words, but I think there is Tony Robbins saying that a lot of people that are very driven, they are always trying to please someone since when they were kids.
zh: 我不记得确切的话了,但我记得 Tony Robbins 说过,很多非常有干劲的人,从小时候开始就一直在试图取悦某个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think it's one of their parents.
zh: 而且我觉得那通常是他们的父母之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: He says, you're always trying to please one of your parents, or maybe, you know, it might be slightly different based on childhood.
zh: 他说,你总是在试图取悦你的父母之一,或者你知道,可能会因为童年经历而略有不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that is another thing, particularly when I hire chief of staffs, I always make them these questions, and I say, you don't have to answer to me, but if you feel comfortable, think about that.
zh: 所以这是另一件事,尤其是当我招募幕僚长的时候,我总是问他们这些问题,我说,你不必回答我,但如果你觉得自在的话,想一想这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you want to hear something even more specific that everyone gets angry at me for, but honestly, I do.
zh: 你想听一些更具体的、大家都会因此生我气的东西吗?但说实话,我确实这么认为。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't care anymore.
zh: 我已经不在乎了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's actually much more specific than that.
zh: 实际上情况比那个具体得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've spent a huge amount of time studying it, which is actually most often it is boys and it is boys relationships with their fathers.
zh: 我花了大量时间研究这个问题,实际上最常见的情况是男孩,是男孩和他们父亲的关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it is a broken relationship with their father where they're trying to prove to them that they can be something they're worthy.
zh: 是一种破裂的父子关系,他们试图向父亲证明自己能有所成就、自己是值得的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is how it most often manifests.
zh: 而这就是最常见的表现形式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very rare is anything to do with mother.
zh: 和母亲有关的情况非常罕见。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, it makes sense.
zh: 是啊,这说得通。

speaker: Unknown
en: Really interesting.
zh: 真有意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you have a relationship with your father?
zh: 你和你父亲的关系怎么样?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, he died, but I had a relationship.
zh: 嗯,他去世了,但我们是有过一段关系的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I still think he's at the bar, and part of what drives me is also probably, if I had to guess, something that, you know, almost to meet the bar, but I don't know.
zh: 但我仍然觉得他在那个标准线上,而驱动我的一部分动力,如果我猜的话,可能也是某种几乎要达到那条线的东西,但我不确定。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did he see Eight Sleep become successful?
zh: 他看到 Eight Sleep 成功了吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's funny because if you go back to when my dad died, I was still a lawyer in Milan.
zh: 有趣的是,如果你回溯到我父亲去世的时候,我还是米兰的一名律师。

speaker: Unknown
en: So he wouldn't know I live in the US.
zh: 所以他不会知道我住在美国。

speaker: Unknown
en: He wouldn't know I'm in Silicon Valley.
zh: 他不会知道我在硅谷。

speaker: Unknown
en: He wouldn't know I'm an entrepreneur.
zh: 他不会知道我是个创业者。

speaker: Unknown
en: He wouldn't know I'm married to a Mexican woman.
zh: 他不会知道我娶了一个墨西哥女人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like it's funny because if you had the cutoff on that date, my life would be so different from what happened after that.
zh: 你知道吗,如果以那个日期为截止点,我的人生会和那之后发生的一切如此不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm the same person, but in two different worlds.
zh: 我是同一个人,却活在两个不同的世界里。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sure he'd be so proud.
zh: 我相信他会非常骄傲的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, yeah.
zh: 是啊,是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Early days was hard because when I started becoming an entrepreneur, my mom didn't want because my mom was a teacher in high school that, you know, in Italy, you make probably a thousand euros, something like that, 1,500.
zh: 早期很艰难,因为当我开始成为创业者的时候,我妈妈不同意,因为我妈妈是高中老师,你知道,在意大利,她大概挣一千欧元左右,一千五那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so she didn't have any means if I would fail as an entrepreneur.
zh: 所以如果我作为创业者失败了,她没有任何能力来支撑。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I was doing well at the law firm, and so I knew that probably my boss would take me back if I would fail as an entrepreneur.
zh: 但我在律所干得不错,所以我知道如果我作为创业者失败了,我的老板大概会让我回去。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I took the risk, but I had the nightmares for many years after that, that I had to go back to the law firm.
zh: 所以我冒了这个险,但在那之后的很多年里,我一直做噩梦,梦见自己不得不回到律所。

speaker: Unknown
en: What advice would you have to a young person in that career on taking risk?
zh: 对于处在那种职业路径上的年轻人,你会给他们什么关于承担风险的建议?

speaker: Unknown
en: I was a law student too, by the way.
zh: 顺便说一下,我也曾是法学院的学生。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, really?
zh: 哦,真的吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't know.
zh: 我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because I was told that that was a secure life.
zh: 因为我被告知那是一种安稳的生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: We didn't have that much money either.
zh: 我们当时也没有太多钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's like, you know that you'll do okay as a lawyer.
zh: 就是说,你知道自己当律师会过得不错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Exactly.
zh: 没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: What would you advise them?
zh: 你会给他们什么建议?

speaker: Unknown
en: So we talk about this with Alex, with my wife, a lot, because we imagine this moment where I'm working.
zh: 我们经常和 Alex、和我妻子讨论这个,因为我们设想这样一个时刻——当时我在工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I come from this city called Ferrara.
zh: 我来自一个叫 Ferrara 的城市。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ferrara is a 150,000-people city in the middle of Italy with a castle in the middle, and there are the walls from 1600-ish all around.
zh: Ferrara 是意大利中部一座十五万人口的城市,市中心有一座城堡,四周环绕着大约 1600 年代建造的城墙。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so now sometimes we joke about, you know, when she comes to Ferrara and we go see my mom, she says, how the hell did you go from this city to the US and Silicon Valley, AI and everything you do?
zh: 所以现在有时我们会开玩笑,你知道,当她来 Ferrara 和我们一起看我妈妈时,她说,你到底是怎么从这座城市走到美国、硅谷、AI 和你所做的一切的?

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we joke about if you were meeting a kid now on the street and he would ask you how to get where you got, what would you tell them?
zh: 所以我们开玩笑说,如果你现在在街上遇到一个孩子,他问你怎么才能达到你现在的成就,你会告诉他什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: And the funny thing is I thought about this a lot, but I don't have an answer.
zh: 有趣的是,这个问题我想了很多,但我没有答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know.
zh: 我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just kept moving things.
zh: 我只是一直在不停地挪动各种东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: I saw opportunity.
zh: 我看到了机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: I went for the opportunity.
zh: 我就去抓住那个机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: I failed here, but that opportunity unlocked that other opportunity on this connection.
zh: 我在这里失败了，但那个机会又解锁了另一条人脉上的另一个机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it's impossible to explain how you go from...
zh: 所以说，你根本没法解释你是怎么从……

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't even speak English until when I was 24.
zh: 我到 24 岁之前连英语都不会说。

speaker: Unknown
en: I almost knew nothing about computers until then.
zh: 在那之前我对计算机几乎一无所知。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then after I graduated, I saved enough money with my first tiny startup, call it startup in Italy.
zh: 然后毕业之后，我靠我的第一个小创业攒够了钱，姑且叫它在意大利的创业吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then my dad took a loan to send me to San Diego to study English.
zh: 然后我爸贷了一笔款，送我去圣地亚哥学英语。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then with that loan, I was able, because I graduated with honor, to get into the big law firms.
zh: 然后靠那笔贷款，因为我是以优异成绩毕业的，我得以进入那些大律所。

speaker: Unknown
en: But even there, everything changed.
zh: 但就算在那里，一切都变了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'll tell you this story because my mom one day brought back home.
zh: 我给你讲这个故事，因为有一天我妈带回家……

speaker: Unknown
en: I was around 20, 21, right?
zh: 我当时大概 20、21 岁吧，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, I was 20.
zh: 不，我 20 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was my first year of college and Italy was four years.
zh: 那是我大学第一年，意大利的大学是四年制。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was not a great student.
zh: 而且我不是个好学生。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hated school.
zh: 我讨厌上学。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was terrible.
zh: 我很糟糕。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I started university with just no mid-level grades.
zh: 所以我开始上大学的时候成绩只有中等水平。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I didn't like the idea of becoming a lawyer, just a traditional lawyer in this small town doing tiny things.
zh: 但我不喜欢那种当一个传统律师、在这个小城镇做些小事的想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted something international.
zh: 我想要更国际化的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she brings this magazine that was coming with this journal called Sole 24 Ore, which is the Italian Wall Street Journal, right?
zh: 然后她带来这本杂志，是随一份叫 Sole 24 Ore 的报纸附送的，它就是意大利版的《华尔街日报》，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And this magazine was talking about these big law firms that they were doing these international transactions, doing IPOs and securities.
zh: 而这本杂志讲的是那些大律所在做这些国际交易、做 IPO 和证券业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I started learning about these law firms and I discovered that the only way you can get in are two conditions.
zh: 于是我开始了解这些律所，然后我发现想进去只有两个条件。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to speak English and you need to graduate with mania cum laude.
zh: 你得会说英语，而且你得以最优等（mania cum laude）毕业。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then in my typical faction, I say, okay, if those are the two conditions, I'll get it done.
zh: 然后按我一贯的作风，我说，好，既然就这两个条件，那我就把它搞定。

speaker: Unknown
en: In Italy, the scores when you go to college are from 18 to 30.
zh: 在意大利，上大学的分数是从 18 到 30 分。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was averaging 23.
zh: 我当时平均 23 分。

speaker: Unknown
en: From that moment on, it was 30 with Magna Cum Laude, almost every single exam.
zh: 从那一刻起，几乎每一门考试都是 30 分外加 Magna Cum Laude。

speaker: Unknown
en: I graduated in Magna Cum Laude.
zh: 我以最优等成绩毕业了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We take the loan.
zh: 我们去贷了那笔款。

speaker: Unknown
en: I go to the bank with my dad.
zh: 我和我爸一起去银行。

speaker: Unknown
en: They give him the loan.
zh: 他们给他批了贷款。

speaker: Unknown
en: I go to San Diego, learn English, and then I get into Freshfields, then Alan Neori, and then I become an entrepreneur.
zh: 我去圣地亚哥学英语，然后我进了 Freshfields，接着是 Alan Neori，再然后我成了创业者。

speaker: Unknown
en: But why?
zh: 但为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I can tell you, we used to go to Chelsea Football Club every week and we didn't have that much money, sat in regular seats that weren't very good.
zh: 我可以告诉你，我们以前每周都去切尔西足球俱乐部看球，我们没什么钱，坐在很普通的、不太好的座位上。

speaker: Unknown
en: This sounds really descriptive and weird.
zh: 这听起来描述得很具体、很怪。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hated the smell of beer and it was horribly like aggressive in football stadiums back in 2000.
zh: 我讨厌啤酒味，2000 年那会儿足球场里可怕地充满攻击性。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could never pee at halftime because there were too many men trying to get in and I was five, six, seven, eight.
zh: 中场休息你永远上不了厕所，因为有太多男人挤着进去，而我当时才五、六、七、八岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then one day, a friend of mine who was very rich took me to their box or corporate and it was beautiful.
zh: 然后有一天，我一个非常有钱的朋友带我去了他们的包厢，企业包厢，那里太美了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It didn't stink of beer.
zh: 没有啤酒的臭味。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wasn't aggressive and horrible.
zh: 没有攻击性和糟糕的氛围。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could pee at halftime.
zh: 中场休息能上厕所。

speaker: Unknown
en: And don't laugh.
zh: 别笑。

speaker: Unknown
en: My eyes were open to like, oh my God, I hated it before.
zh: 我一下子眼界打开了，天哪，我以前那么讨厌看球。

speaker: Unknown
en: And life was so much better with money.
zh: 而有了钱，生活好太多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it gave me drive.
zh: 这给了我动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Where do you pin yours to?
zh: 你把你的动力归结为什么呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I think I always had that drive because I was doing a lot of sports before, right?
zh: 嗯，我觉得我一直都有那种动力，因为我之前做很多运动，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So when I was a teenager, I was playing tennis competitive.
zh: 所以我十几岁的时候，是打竞技网球的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you've got to change your life to go from 23 to 30 and to get magna cum laude and speak English and go to San Diego.
zh: 但你得改变自己的人生，从 23 岁到 30 岁，拿到优等成绩，学会说英语，去圣地亚哥。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know.
zh: 我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just clicked.
zh: 我就是突然开窍了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's funny because, at least in terms of anything school-related, I never had that.
zh: 有趣的是，至少在学校相关的事情上，我从来没有过那种感觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then I'm the type of guy that when I have a goal, then you don't stop me.
zh: 但我是那种一旦有了目标，你就拦不住我的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I become a beast.
zh: 就是，我会变成一头猛兽。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I will outwork you.
zh: 就是，我会在投入度上压过你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, you can't stop me.
zh: 就是，你拦不住我。

speaker: Unknown
en: And something clicked.
zh: 然后某个东西就突然开窍了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is what happened back then.
zh: 当年就是这么回事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then the why, I don't know.
zh: 至于为什么，我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just think I didn't want to work for the tiny two people, law firm of my dad doing things in Ferrara.
zh: 我只是觉得我不想在我爸那个费拉拉的小小两人律师事务所干活。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is that your greatest weakness?
zh: 那是不是你最大的缺点？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because I too am like you, but that's why I'm having a hip operation at 30.
zh: 因为我跟你一样，但这就是为什么我 30 岁就要做髋部手术。

speaker: Unknown
en: My shoulder is fucked and my knee is unrepairable.
zh: 我的肩膀废了，膝盖也没法修了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can't run anymore because I ran 100 mile races so often that my body's just so broken.
zh: 我没法再跑步了，因为我跑 100 英里比赛跑得太频繁，身体彻底垮了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a beast.
zh: 我是一头猛兽。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a broken beast.
zh: 我是一头垮掉的猛兽。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the scene.
zh: 这就是那个场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what I was telling you before.
zh: 这就是我之前跟你说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a scene.
zh: 我有一个场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can't stop.
zh: 我停不下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you can put me on a boat in Sardinia, I like so much what I do that then the downside is I don't stop and I get bored after a few days.
zh: 如果你能把我放到撒丁岛的一艘船上——我是说我太喜欢我做的事情了——那缺点就是停不下来，几天之后我就会觉得无聊。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that is why we call it the scene.
zh: 所以我们才把它叫做那个场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can't relax, right?
zh: 没法放松，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you ever want to?
zh: 你有想过要放松吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like one thing for me is I lie in bed at night and actually like my mind races and it's kind of sometimes very lonely alone in my head at night.
zh: 比如对我来说有一件事，我晚上躺在床上，脑子转个不停，有时候深夜独自在脑子里待着挺孤独的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now the people I admire the most
zh: 现在我最敬佩的人

speaker: Unknown
en: No outside business, no right people that you want to emulate, are really people that you might find in many places in the world, but call it in Italy because I'm Italian, that are on the beach, that they're just walking.
zh: 不是商业圈外的，对，你想要效仿的真正的人，其实是那种你在世界很多地方都能找到的人，就叫它意大利吧，因为我是意大利人，在海滩上，就那么散着步的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Actually, there is this guy.
zh: 其实，有这么一位先生。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were having dinner like last week, my wife and I, and we see this gentleman, and he's having dinner in a pretty nice restaurant.
zh: 大概上周，我和我太太在吃晚饭，我们看到这位先生，他在一家相当不错的餐厅吃晚饭。
